$comment: PDIG Design Tokens — brand truth shared by all three platforms. Extracted from app/theme/tokens.uts @ 6d268c0. UI code is NOT generated from this file; only the token values and copy keys are shared. Each platform maps these to its native design system (Material 3 / ArkUI / SwiftUI) and MUST keep brand, content, domain semantics, key CTAs and user flow identical.

policy.colorRule: pages MUST NOT hardcode color literals; only palette values and status role colours are allowed

statusRoles.$comment: Semantic status -> foreground colour. Both light and dark MUST define these; a status MUST NOT be communicated by colour alone.
statusRoles.note: Soft backgrounds are enumerated explicitly; do NOT synthesise them by appending alpha to a 6-digit hex, since 8-digit hex is not guaranteed on every native platform.

requirements: status is never conveyed by colour alone - always pair with text
screen reader labels on every interactive element
large text must not clip critical content

darkMode.requirement: System / Light / Dark if the native design system supports it cheaply
darkMode.fallback: at minimum the token layer must be ready (this file) even if the toggle is not yet exposed
darkMode.note: Light remains the default in MVP.
